en.headline: Lawmaker urges more checks as illegal parking fines top HK$70 million a year
en.dek: Police issued more than 220,000 fixed-penalty tickets for metered parking offences in each of the past three years, generating at least HK$70 million annually, according to a government reply.
body: Lawmaker Mark Chong has called for stepped-up inspections and the use of AI-powered sensors to track repeat illegal parking offenders, after figures showed traffic police issued more than 220,000 tickets for parking-related offences in each of the past three years.

In a written reply to the Legislative Council on Wednesday, Secretary for Transport and Logistics Mable Chan said police issued 259,589, 242,550 and 225,489 fixed-penalty tickets in 2023, 2024 and 2025 respectively to drivers who breached metered parking regulations.

The tickets carried a fine of HK$320 before January this year and generated at least HK$70 million a year for the government over the past three years, the reply stated. Chong said inspections could be enhanced to target more offenders.

The figures relate specifically to metered parking offences. Separately, overall illegal parking enforcement numbers have been higher in recent years, though the government reply focused on the metered category.

zh.headline: 議員促加強巡查 違泊「牛肉乾」年收逾7000萬元
zh.dek: 政府書面回覆指，過去三年警方每年發出逾22萬張咪錶違泊定額罰款告票，每年至少帶來7000萬元收入。
body: 立法會議員莊豪鋒促請當局加強巡查，並考慮使用人工智能感應器追蹤屢犯違泊人士。政府回覆顯示，過去三年警方每年就泊車相關罪行發出逾22萬張告票。
運輸及物流局局長陳美寶周三書面回覆立法會時指，警方於2023、2024及2025年分別發出259,589、242,550及225,489張定額罰款告票，對象為違反咪錶泊車規例的駕駛者。
這些告票在今年一月前每張罰款320元，過去三年每年至少為庫房帶來7000萬元收入。莊豪鋒表示，當局可加強巡查，以針對更多違規者。
有關數字主要涉及咪錶泊車罪行。整體違例泊車執法數字近年較高，但今次回覆聚焦咪錶類別。
Correction: 早前版本中「咪錶」一詞曾出現錯字，現已更正。
